title: Repo pages with a blank Status tab although the repo has plans
why: Owner ask ask-mw1exqmkne (Nov 3 19:03 CST): some repos' pages show a blank roadmap but the repos have plans.
note: Known causes, from skill waiting-page 'Update the roadmap block': the Status tab shows only steps baked from the repo's roadmap record branch; plans in docs/plans count only in the Records view.
